subject: SLA pricing ladder and timing for pilot -> commit
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan@bluenova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLA proposal & packaging options

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached is a concise SLA proposal that maps to the pilot we discussed and a recommended path to a committed Dedicated tier. High-level notes: 

- Pilot (90 days): 99.5% target uptime, 4 prioritized incident responses per month (P1/P2 triage within 2 hours), monthly usage-based billing.
- Commit (annual): 99.9% target uptime, 24/7 escalation coverage (primary on-call + named technical account lead), reduced per-token price and a 10% seat discount at $50k MRR threshold.
- Fallbacks: automated model variant routing for regional capacity spikes, and automatic read-only mode for non-critical endpoints during extended incidents.

Open questions for BlueNova:
1) Is the 90-day pilot length workable for your procurement timeline?
2) Do you need a stricter P1 response SLA (e.g., <1 hour) for production go-live?
3) Any internal constraints around contract signers or SSO/KMS timing?

I've included an annotated pricing sheet (BlueNova_SLA_annotated.xlsx) with two concession scenarios: (A) limited one-time onboarding credit and (B) expanded retainer with slightly higher flat monthly fee but deeper per-token discounts.

If this looks directionally right, I'll coordinate with Marissa to prepare a concise purchase addendum and a DocuSign packet for the legal team.

Next step: quick sync on Monday to confirm pilot start date and any legal milestones.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: 20251101_BlueNova_SLA_Proposal.pdf, BlueNova_SLA_annotated.xlsx

From: Jordan Park <jordan@bluenova.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@bluenova.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@bluenova.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA proposal & packaging options

Naomi — thanks for the clear summary and prompt follow-up. A few immediate points from our side: 

- Pilot length: we'd prefer a 60-day tech-eval followed by a 30-day business validation (same as your 90 days but we split the signoff cadence). That helps us accelerate the procurement paperwork.
- P1 response: for external-facing APIs tied to customer billing, we do need a 1-hour P1 acknowledgement and a 4-hour remediation SLA (we understand tool-dependent fallout and are open to escalation credits if missed).
- Pricing: the per-token reduction under the Commit scenario is attractive, but we were hoping for an additional 5% accelerator if we hit 2x usage in Q1 post-commit.
- Security/legal: our contracts team needs confirmation about data residency (US only) and confirmation that Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II evidence within 30 days of signature.

We should also confirm who will be the signatory for the purchase order — Contracts Team will handle, but Alex will coordinate.

Can you loop in Marissa/Kimberly to confirm whether the 1-hour P1 acknowledgement is supported by your current Response Ladder or if that's an escalation package addition?

Thanks,
Jordan Park
Head of Platform Engineering — BlueNova Labs
jordan@bluenova.com

Subject: Re: SLA proposal & packaging options

Jordan — quick internal alignment and proposal on the asks. Thanks Naomi for the draft.

1) P1 acknowledgement at 1 hour: we can offer that as part of the "Rapid Acknowledge" add-on. It is typically sold as a premium retainer (adds a small fixed monthly fee). If BlueNova commits to the annual Dedicated tier within 45 days of pilot completion we can include the Rapid Acknowledge add-on for the first 3 months at no charge.

2) 2x usage accelerator: we can implement a step discount: +5% rebate applied retroactively if Q1 post-commit usage exceeds the baseline by 100% — conditioned on usage verification and single audit. We'll add a clause in the addendum.

3) SOC2 and data residency: SOC2 Type II report is available; we'll deliver the current report under NDA within 10 business days of LOI. Data residency in US-only regions is supported for Dedicated; we'll flag the relevant region in the purchase addendum.

Proposed next steps:
- Naomi and I will prepare a short purchase addendum capturing: pilot cadence (60/30 split), Rapid Acknowledge add-on with promotional waiver, 2x usage accelerator clause, data residency checkbox, and a DocuSign-ready signature line for BlueNova Contracts.
- Internal: Kimberly, can you estimate the incremental monthly retainer figure for Rapid Acknowledge (baseline + promotional waiver) so Naomi can preview numbers before we send to Contracts?

Naomi — happy to jump on a 30-min call with Jordan + Alex tomorrow PST to finalize wording if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Deals — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Finalized addendum & DocuSign (pilot cadence + Rapid Acknowledge promo)

Jordan — thanks for the quick turn. Per Marissa's note I've attached the final one-page addendum and a redline summary showing the promotional waiver for Rapid Acknowledge and the 2x usage accelerator clause. Key finalized points: 

- Pilot cadence: 60-day technical eval followed by a 30-day business validation (starts on pilot kick-off).
- Rapid Acknowledge: 1-hour P1 acknowledgement included free for the first 3 months after Commit if BlueNova signs annual Dedicated within 45 days of pilot end. After promotional period, standard Rapid Acknowledge retainer applies.
- 2x accelerator: 5% retroactive rebate applied after verified usage spike in Q1; audit window 45 days.
- SOC2: we'll deliver the report under NDA within 10 business days of LOI.
- Data residency: Dedicated deployment will be provisioned in US-West region; addendum includes checkbox for region confirmation.

I've created a DocuSign packet: https://docusign.com/link/ABC123-BLU-2025 — Contracts Team, please review and provide the expected PO signer and any required PO number.

If that looks good I'll move the packet to Alex and Contracts for signature. If you want one more quick sync, I can make time Thursday afternoon PST.

Thanks and looking forward to closing this pilot flow.

—
